camel_example: aliyun vpc CreateIPv6Translator --region cn-hangzhou --PricingCycle Month --Bandwidth 10 --Duration 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PayType PREPAY --AutoPay false --ClientToken sha111 --Spec small --Name ipv6_1
description_en: Creates an IPv6 Translation Service instance
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-ipv6-translator --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token sha111 --name ipv6_1 --spec small --pay-type PREPAY --pricing-cycle Month --duration 1 --auto-pay false --bandwidth 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateIPv6Translator

parameters.help_en: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例的地域。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client token must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端token用于保证请求的幂等性。要保证Client Token在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. The name defaults to the instance ID. The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), but cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例的名称，默认为实例ID。长度为2~100个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、点号（.）、下划线（_）和短横线（-）。但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The specification of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. Valid values: small
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例的规格。取值：small
parameters.name: spec

parameters.help_en:
The payment method of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. Valid values: 

PREPAY: subscription.

POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6转换服务实例的付费类型。取值： 

PREPAY：包年包月。

POSTPAY：按量计费
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle for subscription. Valid values: 

Month (default): monthly subscription.

Year: yearly subscription
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月的计费周期，取值： 

Month（默认值）：按月购买。

Year：按年购买。
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

If the billing cycle is Month, valid values are 1 to 9.  
If the billing cycle is Year, the value is 3
parameters.help_zh:
购买时长，取值：

如果计费时长为Month，则取值为1~9。  
如果计费时长为Year，则取值为3。
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether automatic payment is enabled for the subscription bill. Valid values: true|false
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动支付包年包月账单。取值：true|false
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The billing bandwidth of the IPv6 Translation Service instance, in Mbit/s. Valid values: 1 to 200. If you do not set the bandwidth for translation mapping entries, the mapping entries in the instance share this bandwidth. 

If you do not specify the bandwidth, the default value is 10 Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6转换服务实例的计费带宽（Mbps）。取值：1~200。若不设置转换映射条目的带宽，实例中的IPv6转换服务映射条目共享该带宽。 

若不指定带宽，默认为10Mbps。
parameters.name: bandwidth

Ipv6TranslatorId.description_en: The ID of the IPv6 Translation Service instance

Name.description_en: The name of the IPv6 Translation Service instance

OrderId.description_en: The order ID for creating the IPv6 Translation Service instance
OrderId.description_zh: 创建IPv6转换服务实例的订单ID

Spec.description_en: The specification of the IPv6 Translation Service instance
